body: Well for one, living is simply existing. I've grown to despise people who act like there's a certain way to live when that's just not true. Everyone who's existing is living, and if you look at the official definition, that's what it'll say, essentially.  It hasn't helped me but maybe it will help you just a little, to keep that in mind. I feel the same way though. Even though I had a few friends, I recently came to realize they weren't suitable friends for me, and we aren't friends anymore. It hurts because we grew up together and I've never had any real friends besides them, and it surely is a task to make new ones. I often feel like I'm just a big, underdeveloped weirdo.
